integrity: All critical finite results and certificate checks can be replayed with the bundled standalone Python script; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact assertions are restricted to rooted binary trees on three through six leaves. The six-leaf VC upper bound uses exhaustive finite enumeration and the adaptive lower bound a complete explicit depth-nine certificate. Historical priority is not exhaustively established.
title: Exact static and adaptive shattering of six-leaf rooted triplet systems
